Belmonte already knows you betrayed him. He is going to come after us, so we are going to go first.

Cobras. Un favor que se cobra ya no es u: You collect. A favor that gets paid is no longer a favor.

Cómo se juega con amigos. No hace falta: How to play with friends. No server is needed: your own game acts as the server.

Dani. I'm told you are looking for people.
Defiende el almacén: acaba con los tres: Defend the warehouse: take out the three Calaveras. Q locks onto the enemy, Space fires, R reloads and X makes you duck so you get hit less.

Dicho así suena fatal. Llévalo a la Nave: Said like that it sounds terrible. Take it to the Industrial Warehouse in the industrial estate; a technician friend of mine will pull the recording.

El Faro ha publicado la historia. El com: El Faro has published the story. Chief Varela is trying to flee.
El Tabulador recorre lo que tienes alred: Tab scans what is around you, from the closest to the farthest, and each thing sounds from where it is. Shift Tab goes backward. With F6 you choose whether you want to hear everything, or only places, vehicles, people or objects.
El café te lo pongo yo. Y las llaves del: The coffee is on me. And the keys to Grandma's apartment, may she rest in peace. It is on Calle Mayor, right next door.

El escáner son las teclas W, A, S y D: t: The scanner is the W, A, S and D keys: they tell you what is ahead, to the left, behind and to the right, and how far away the wall is. Use it like a cane.

El piso sigue igual: el hule de la mesa,: The apartment is just the same: the oilcloth on the table, the cuckoo clock, the photo of your father next to his taxi. You set the duffel bag on the floor. You are home.
El portero del hotel abre las puertas tr: The hotel doorman opens the back doors, looks inside, whistles and puts an envelope in your hand without a word.
El proveedor de Encarna te da las gracia: Encarna's supplier thanks you and takes out his wallet. What do you do?
El tendero vacía la caja sobre el mostra: The shopkeeper empties the till onto the counter without looking at you.
El último de la lista es un tendero que: The last one on the list is a shopkeeper who can't make ends meet. Belmonte wants his money. What do you do?
En conducción asistida el coche sigue su: In assisted driving the car follows its lane by itself. You accelerate with the up arrow and brake with the down arrow. Before an intersection, the left or right arrow turns on the turn signal and the car turns by itself.
En cuanto coges el maletín, un hombre co: As soon as you grab the briefcase, a man with an earpiece points at you and shouts. It was a police trap!

En el menú del embarcadero puedes alquil: In the pier menu you can rent a boat, set sail with a boat of your own if you have one, or take one without permission. When you set sail you appear at sea, on board.
En tus casas puedes guardar la partida,: At your homes you can save the game, rest to recover health and leave vehicles in the garage. Press Enter at the door to go in.
En un tiroteo de verdad, medio segundo a: In a real shootout, half a second before shooting you the enemy cocks the weapon: that is your warning to duck with X. Z uses a first aid kit.
Encarna necesita que le hagas un recado: Encarna needs you to run an errand in the neighborhood.

Encarna y El Chispas quieren golpear a B: Encarna and El Chispas want to hit Belmonte where it hurts most.
Esa noche, en La Gaviota, Encarna invita: That night, at La Gaviota, Encarna treats the whole neighborhood. El Chispas sings, La Rusa almost smiles and you look out the window at your city. Puerto Bravo belongs to its people again.

This is ending, Auntie. I'm going after him.
